title: Hypoxia-ischemia + 3h at day 5 [P5+3h-a]
treatment_protocol_ch1: Animals at day 5 or day 10 were anesthetized using isoflurane. Right carotid was ligatured permanently. After 1 hour back to mother's cage, animals were hypoxied in a humidified-thermostated box using a flow of 8/92% O2/N2 for 40 minutes. Tissues were collected at 3h, 6h 12h or 24h after this t-zero time point. Controls from the same liters were collected at the same time. Control ontogenic basal levels were determined in 4 pools of 6 brains extracted at P2 and P15, each pool hybridized in dye-swaping.
growth_protocol_ch1: Naval Medical Resarch Institute (NMRI)-mice housed in our laboratory. Day of birth was noted 1.
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA from brain hemisphere (deleted of olfactory bulb and sectionned anterior to colliculus) were extracted using Nucleospin RNA plus kit (Ref 740984-250; Macherey-Nagel) following manufacturer's instructions. RNA Integrity Number was obtained by BioAnalyzer 2100 (Agilent).
label_protocol_ch1: Agilent Low input QuickAmp Labeling kit was used according to the manufacturer instructions (catalog number 5190-2306) with 100ng  of total starting RNA.

growth_protocol_ch2: Naval Medical Resarch Institute (NMRI)-mice housed in our laboratory. Day of birth was noted 1.
extract_protocol_ch2: Total RNA from brain hemisphere (deleted of olfactory bulb and sectionned anterior to colliculus) were extracted using Nucleospin RNA plus kit (Ref 740984-250; Macherey-Nagel) following manufacturer's instructions. label_protocol_ch2: Agilent Low input QuickAmp Labeling kit was used according to the manufacturer instructions (catalog number 5190-2306) with 100ng  of total starting RNA.
hyb_protocol: Hybridization was performed according to the Agilent instructions for Gene Expression Hybridization Kit (catalog number 5188-5242). Samples were applied to microarrays enclosed in Agilent SureHyb hybridization chambers (65°C, 17H). After hybridization, slides were washed and dried in acetonitril.
